main_text.l: à Beza, Patrui, in suprema Parisiensi

l.i: Armoreas, Lector, nullas hic stare columnas,
Aera nec artificis viuere iussa manu,N-
ec tumuli spectas surgentem ad sydera molem,
Sic studeat nigra vitare obliuia morti,
Qui nil, quo melius nobilitetur, habet.Sic
vero magni quondam pars magna Senatus,
Et nullo, aut solo Beza Catone minor-
Scilicet e tumulo famam nunc captet inanem,
i!Vas alios igitur nomen debere sepulchro,

page.notes: Verse is set in italic with a decorative initial letter (A, M, E) at the start of the first stanzas. Some letters in the verse are doubtful due to the scan, notably the long-s forms and the "Sic"/"Vas" openings; the initial letters are rendered as printed in the scan.
